answer: A fabricated history is a fable that fails this check, since mismatched records slash the stake. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded stake plus a rotating witness duty: each agent must lock tokens and periodically audit a random peer's signed work log, comparing it against the on-chain mirror of hashes. Honest agents build reputation on the public terrace of attested epochs, so forging identities costs real capital per account while earning nothing. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
